description: QuantConnect LEAN repository sample equity data (daily + minute trade/quote bars, factor/map files)

extra.received_ts_semantics: LEAN commit timestamp (vintage of the source snapshot)

limitations: Historical QuantConnect LEAN repository sample data (old vintage, adjustment provenance unknown) — not current market prices

Source: QuantConnect LEAN repository sample data (Data/equity/usa) at the pinned commit; old vintage (exact minute-file days and daily range are listed in this manifest's extra.coverage) — not current prices
Adjustment provenance unknown: treated as raw; values may include later vendor revisions (PIT of values not guaranteed)
Sample data credited to AlgoSeek in LEAN's Data/equity/usa/readme.md ('all rights reserved'); local research/testing use only, do not redistribute
Minute quotes are LEAN quote-bar closes (last top of book inside each minute), not tick-level NBBO
Extended-hours minute bars are preserved in raw Parquet but rejected from normalized tables (regular session only)
Data period: daily bars 1998-01-02..2021-03-31; minute bars only on a few sample days in 2008, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2023 — old historical sample, not current market data
